description.text: The scene opens in an unlit garage bay, the air still and the concrete floor disappearing into black. A faint, narrow pool of cool light hovers in the distance, enough to catch drifting dust and the polished edge of the floor but not enough to reveal the space around it. The

waits inside the darkness, its outline barely separable from the background; only a soft highlight along one panel and the dull glint of its front edge suggest a solid shape. At first the vehicle is almost motionless, a low engine rumble building from near silence. The

then begins to roll forward, slowly and steadily, its nose cutting into the first trace of illumination. As it advances, more of the body emerges: the hood, the headlight housings, and the long flank slide out of shadow in stages, each surface taking on a faint sheen. The paint holds a restrained gloss, the tires stay matte, and the glass remains dark except for a thin reflected line of light. The engine note stays low and textured, felt as much as heard. The

continues until its front half is clearly visible at the edge of the light, while the rear is still swallowed by black. It settles there with a slight suspension dip, the rumble easing but not vanishing, leaving the surrounding garage dark and quiet.
